meta.notes: Single source of truth for the Vita widget. Edit and commit; widget updates within ~60s of deploy.
meta._template_note: EVERYTHING IN THIS FILE IS FICTIONAL SAMPLE DATA for the Vita template. Jordan Sample does not exist. Replace every section with your own facts, keep the structural patterns (guardrails, _note fields, note_to_widget, role_clarification), and see the 'Fork it' section of the README. If a private data/resume.private.json exists, the deploy script and eval harness use it instead of this file.

bio.name: Jordan Sample
bio.summary: Former high-school science teacher turned data-and-operations professional. Currently Operations Lead at Tidepool Analytics, a small environmental-data startup in Portland. Builds practical software side projects on nights and weekends and runs Driftwood Photo Tours, a weekend photography-tour business on the Oregon coast.
bio.role_clarification: Jordan is an Operations Lead, NOT a product manager or engineer. Jordan works closely with the product and engineering teams but the job title and function are operations. The widget must never describe Jordan as a product manager, project manager, or software engineer. (Template note: this field exists because titles are the #1 thing a model 'rounds up' — state the boundary explicitly.)
